description: Two deployments of different fixture workloads on one target sharing the postgres resource. Upgrade, rollback, retirement and cleanup of one must leave the survivor serving, its data intact and its public route present.

shared_dependencies.lifecycle_rule: stopped only when no owned deployment demands it

journey.invariant: both external probes healthy; shared resource started once
survivor probe never fails; survivor data digest unchanged
survivor unaffected; shared resource not restarted
survivor serving; shared resource still running because survivor demands it; subject route removed; subject data disposition explicit
zero unexplained owned resources; survivor state equals its pre-journey oracle

ownership.cleanup_owner: scenario-to-cloud fixture lease (routed test storage + owned target)
ownership.neighbor_invariant: Unrelated operator data, processes, files and network rules remain unchanged after setup and cleanup (P02-A03).
ownership.write_scope_invariant: Every SQL and file write made while the fixture is leased belongs to its lease scope and its owned target (P02-A02).

lifecycle.note: Setup and teardown argv are returned by the fixture owner at lease time as typed {verb, argv[]} actions; no owner runtime exists at phase 2, so none are recorded here. Never a shell string.
